ChargeMethod.description: How the length a charge debits was worked out.

oneOf.description: A completed print: the length the file's analysis gives.
The extrusion the file's own moves add up to, up to a position in it.

The analysed length scaled by how far into the file the print got; the
fallback used only when the file itself could not be read.
A completed print this system never saw: the file's analysed length.

FilePosition.description: How far into its file a print had got, and when that was read.

bytes.description: The byte the printer had read the file up to.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, when it was known.

PendingCharge.description:
Filament a tool fed after a filament change nobody has confirmed, held until
somebody says which spool fed it.

A length rather than grams, because the grams follow the spool that takes
it.

analysed_length_mm.description: The file's analysed length for the tool, in millimetres, when it had one.

charge_key.description:
The print segment the filament was fed in, which names the print and
the tool that fed it.

length_mm.description: How much was fed, in millimetres.

method.description: How that length was worked out.

note.description: Anything a reader needs to make sense of the figure.

position.description: How far into the file the segment ran, when that was read.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

PrintSegmentKey.description:
One segment of a print this system watched, on one tool: the key of a
[`ChargeKey::Print`] debit, and the only key filament held pending can be
under.

segment.description: Which segment, numbered as [`ChargeKey::Print`] numbers it.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
Filament a tool fed after an unconfirmed filament change was held for the
